summary: axod opens its catalog, restores what was open, repairs session invariants, then starts accepting attachments and reaping exits.

steps.action: open SQLite catalog (WAL, synchronous=FULL, foreign keys) and migrate schema to user_version 7 in one transaction
load or create host ID, agent.command, shell.command and last client viewport
generate a new host generation (per boot)
create the private pi-sessions directory (0700); remove abandoned Pi bridge sockets
restore Workspace directory access from stored security-scoped bookmarks
restore open sessions: respawn terminal panes; mark Pi panes unavailable
properties: terminal output history is not restored

steps.action: create a session in every open Workspace that has none
create a standalone home session if none is open
